4084-the-adventures-of-peregrine-pickle.title: The Adventures Of Peregrine Pickle
4084-the-adventures-of-peregrine-pickle.creator: Tobias Smollett
4084-the-adventures-of-peregrine-pickle.description: A book by Tobias Smollett. The sallies of his youth, far from being inordinate or criminal, never exceeded the bounds of that decent jollity which an extraordinary pot, on extraordinary occasions, may be supposed to have produced in a club of sedate book-keepers, whose imaginations were neither very warm nor luxuriant. Little subject to refined sensations, he was scarce ever disturbed with violent emotions of any kind. The passion of love never interrupted his tranquility; and if, as Mr. Creech says, after Horace,

63455-the-vanishing-comrade-a-mystery-st.title: _A Mystery Story for Girls_
63455-the-vanishing-comrade-a-mystery-st.creator: Ethel Cook Eliot
63455-the-vanishing-comrade-a-mystery-st.description: A book by Ethel Cook Eliot. To-morrow summer holidays would begin. They nodded a friendly good-bye to the driver and started off up the steep little elm-roofed street that sloped directly up to Ashland College, an institution for girls, perched on the highest plateau of this hill town. The boys’ father was a professor in that college and the girl’s mother an instructor.

70913-harilek.title: _A Romance_
70913-harilek.creator: “Ganpat”
70913-harilek.description: A book by “Ganpat”. Most of the big things in life hinge on very small beginnings. I wonder if the people who pose as pure materialists ever reflect on that fact when they hold forth on their complete and absolute certainty that there is no guiding hand in men’s affairs or in the conception, creation, and control of that most wonderfully intricate piece of machinery, the universe.

arxiv-1904-10547.title: Vortex dynamics under pulsatile flow in axisymmetric constricted tubes
arxiv-1904-10547.creator: Nicasio Barrere, Javier Brum, Alexandre L’Her, Gustavo L. Sarasúa, Cecilia Cabeza
arxiv-1904-10547.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Nicasio Barrere, Javier Brum, Alexandre L’Her, Gustavo L. Sarasúa, Cecilia Cabeza. An improved understanding of how vortices develop and propagate under pulsatile flow can shed important light on the mixing and transport processes including the transition to turbulent regime occurring in such systems. For example, the characterization of pulsatile flows in obstructed artery models serves to encourage research into flow-induced phenomena associated with changes in morphology, blood viscosity, wall elasticity and flow rate.

arxiv-1909-06581.title: Blind Super-Resolution Kernel Estimation using an Internal-GAN
arxiv-1909-06581.creator: Sefi Bell-Kligler, Assaf Shocher, Michal Irani
arxiv-1909-06581.description: Abstract Super resolution (SR) methods typically assume that the low-resolution (LR) image was downscaled from the unknown high-resolution (HR) image by a fixed ‘ideal’ downscaling kernel (e.g. Bicubic downscaling). However, this is rarely the case in real LR images , in contrast to synthetically generated SR datasets.

arxiv-2210-10919.title: Realization of a fractional quantum Hall state with ultracold atoms
arxiv-2210-10919.creator: Julian Léonard, Sooshin Kim, Joyce Kwan, Perrin Segura, Fabian Grusdt, Cécile Repellin, Nathan Goldman, Markus Greiner
arxiv-2210-10919.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Julian Léonard, Sooshin Kim, Joyce Kwan, Perrin Segura, Fabian Grusdt, Cécile Repellin, Nathan Goldman, Markus Greiner. August 9, 2026 Strongly interacting topological matter Wen 2007 exhibits fundamentally new phenomena with potential applications in quantum information technology A.Yu. Kitaev 2002 ; Nayak et al. Emblematic instances are fractional quantum Hall states Giuliani and Vignale 2012 , where the interplay of magnetic fields and strong interactions gives rise to fractionally charged quasi-particles, long-ranged entanglement, and anyonic exchange statistics.

arxiv-2301-04342.title: Massive vector particle tunneling from Kerr-Newman-de Sitter black hole under generalized uncertainty principle
arxiv-2301-04342.creator: Yenshembam Priyobarta Singh, Telem Ibungochouba Singh
arxiv-2301-04342.description: Abstract The quantum tunneling of charged massive vector boson particles across the event horizon of Kerr-Newman-de Sitter black hole is investigated under the influence of quantum gravity effects. The modified Hawking temperatures and heat capacities across the event horizon of KNdS black hole are derived in 3-dimensional and 4-dimensional frame dragging coordinates.

arxiv-2303-17528.title: Chemical reactions of ultracold alkaline-earth-metal diatomic molecules
arxiv-2303-17528.creator: Hela Ladjimi, Michał Tomza
arxiv-2303-17528.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hela Ladjimi, Michał Tomza. We study the energetics of chemical reactions between ultracold ground-state alkaline-earth-metal diatomic molecules. We show that the atom-exchange reactions forming homonuclear dimers are energetically allowed for all heteronuclear alkaline-earth-metal combinations. We perform high-level electronic structure calculations on the potential energy surfaces of all possible homo- and heteronuclear alkaline-earth-metal trimers and show that trimer formation is also energetically possible in collisions of all considered dimers.

arxiv-2311-13222.title: Towards Detecting, Recognizing, and Parsing the Address Information from Bangla Signboard: A Deep Learning-based Approach
arxiv-2311-13222.creator: Hasan Murad, Mohammed Eunus Ali
arxiv-2311-13222.description: Abstract Retrieving textual information from natural scene images is an active research area in the field of computer vision with numerous practical applications. Detecting text regions and extracting text from signboards is a challenging problem due to special characteristics like reflecting lights, uneven illumination, or shadows found in real-life natural scene images.

arxiv-2312-04566.title: Gen2Det: Generate to Detect
arxiv-2312-04566.creator: Saksham Suri, Fanyi Xiao, Animesh Sinha, Sean Chang Culatana, Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi, Chenchen Zhu, Abhinav Shrivastava, University of Maryland, College Park
arxiv-2312-04566.description: Abstract Recently diffusion models have shown improvement in synthetic image quality as well as better control in generation. We motivate and present Gen2Det, a simple modular pipeline to create synthetic training data for object detection for free by leveraging state-of-the-art grounded image generation methods.

arxiv-2402-07130.title: Existence of weak solutions and long-time asymptotics for hydrodynamic model of swarming
arxiv-2402-07130.creator: Nilasis Chaudhuri, Young-Pil Choi, Oliver Tse, Ewelina Zatorska
arxiv-2402-07130.description: Abstract . We consider a one-dimensional hydrodynamic model featuring nonlocal attraction-repulsion interactions and singular velocity alignment. We introduce a two-velocity reformulation and the corresponding energy-type inequality, in the spirit of the Bresch-Desjardins estimate. We identify a dependence between the communication weight and interaction kernel and between the pressure and viscosity term allowing for this inequality to be uniform in time.

arxiv-2402-18840.title: Turbulence and Magnetic Fields in Star Formation
arxiv-2402-18840.creator: Archana Soam 1,∗, Chakali Eswaraiah 2, Amit Seta 3, Lokesh Dewangan 4, and Maheswar G. 1
arxiv-2402-18840.description: Abstract Molecular clouds are prime locations to study the process of star formation. These clouds contain filamentary structures and cores, which are crucial sites for the formation of young stars. The star-formation process has been investigated using various techniques, including polarimetry for tracing magnetic fields.

arxiv-2412-09944.title: Deterministic steady-state subradiance within a single-excitation basis
arxiv-2412-09944.creator: Meng-Jia Chu 1,3, Jun Ren 1,2,3, Z. D. Wang 1,3, CLEO Collaboration
arxiv-2412-09944.description: Abstract Subradiance shows promising applications in quantum information, yet its realization remains more challenging than superradiance due to the need to suppress various decay channels. This study introduces a state space within a single-excitation basis with perfect subradiance and genuine multipartite quantum entanglement resources for the all-to-all case.

arxiv-2507-09648.title: Constructing the fundamental diagrams of traffic flow from large-scale vehicle trajectory data
arxiv-2507-09648.creator: Zhengbing He, Cathy Wu
arxiv-2507-09648.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhengbing He, Cathy Wu. For decades, researchers and practitioners typically measure macroscopic traffic flow variables, i.e., density, flow, and speed, using time or space cuts, and then construct the fundamental diagrams of traffic flow. With the advent of large-scale vehicle trajectory datasets, often capturing 100% of vehicle dynamics, Edie’s generalized definitions have become widely recognized as the most appropriate framework for measuring these variables.

arxiv-2507-20573.title: Reminiscence Attack on Residuals: Exploiting Approximate Machine Unlearning for Privacy
arxiv-2507-20573.creator: Yaxin Xiao 20034165r@connect.polyu.hk, Qingqing Ye qqing.ye@polyu.edu.hk, Huadi Zheng zhenghuadi@huawei.com, Haibo Hu haibo.hu@polyu.edu.hk, Zi Liang zi1415926.liang@connect.polyu.hk, Haoyang Li hao-yang9905.li@connect.polyu.hk, Yijie Jiao 22103037d@connect.polyu.hk, Department of Electronical and E
arxiv-2507-20573.description: Abstract Machine unlearning enables the removal of specific data from ML models to uphold the right to be forgotten . While approximate unlearning algorithms offer efficient alternatives to full retraining, this work reveals that they fail to adequately protect the privacy of unlearned data. In particular, these algorithms introduce implicit residuals which facilitate privacy attacks targeting at unlearned data.

arxiv-2602-13740.title: The L 2 L^{2} Norm of the Interior Cauchy Transform: Beyond the First Dirichlet Eigenvalue
arxiv-2602-13740.creator: David Kalaj
arxiv-2602-13740.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by David Kalaj. We study sharp L 2 L^{2} bounds for the interior Cauchy transform C D C_{D} on a bounded planar domain D D and clarify its connection with the Dirichlet spectrum. We analyze an approach that replaces fractional Dirichlet powers on D D by Euclidean Fourier multipliers after extension by zero, and show that this substitution can change the optimal constants. In particular, we construct an explicit endpoint counterexample on the unit disk to a Fourier-weighted inequality appearing in [ 5 ] .

britannica-1911-brown-samuel-morison.description: Article 'Brown, Samuel Morison' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 4), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. itinerating libraries, and grandson of John Brown, author of the Self-Interpreting Bible. In 1832 he entered the university of Edinburgh, where, after studying in Berlin and St Petersburg, he graduated as M.D.

pmc-10585281.title: Impact of COVID-19 on investor sentiment in China's stock markets
pmc-10585281.creator: Jianwei Gao, Haiwei Li, Zhou Lu
pmc-10585281.description: Large-scale public health emergencies may exert significant adverse effects on market sentiment. This study utilizes interrupted time series analysis (ITSA) to explore the shift in Chinese investors' sentiment in response to the uncertainties due to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic. The empirical findings demonstrate that COVID-19 had a notable impact on investor sentiment within China's stock markets.

pmc-11344649.title: A Systematic Review and Single-Arm Meta-Analysis on the Efficacy of High-Intensity, Focused Ultrasound for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Treatment: A Forgotten Option?
pmc-11344649.creator: Carlos A Garcia-Becerra, Veronica Soltero-Molinar, Maria I Arias-Gallardo, Jesus E Juarez-Garcia, Natalia Garcia, Leonardo Fernández-Avila, Carlos M Garcia-Gutierrez
pmc-11344649.description: Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is a non-cancerous enlargement of prostate tissue, commonly affecting older men. This condition leads to lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS), which significantly affect the quality of life. Over time, extensive research has been conducted regarding BPH treatment, exploring various treatment options.

pmc-11649335.title: Non-surgical Treatment of Severe Skeletal Class III Malocclusion in an Adolescent Patient: A Case Report
pmc-11649335.creator: Radwan A Haffaf, Bilal F Mahmoud, Mohamad M Younes, Yarob A Ghanem, Mounzer Assad, Abdul-Kareem Hasan
pmc-11649335.description: Class III malocclusion is one of the most challenging malocclusions in orthodontics. Its nature and multifactorial etiology should be taken into consideration, especially in growing and adolescent patients. Many treatment modalities have been proposed. The wide variety of underlying skeletal and dental components of this malocclusion justifies the different treatment options in the literature.

pmc-11692326.title: IDENTIFYING OPPORTUNITIES TO OPTIMIZE PERSON-CENTERED CARE IN LONG-TERM CARE
pmc-11692326.creator: Tonya Roberts, Jingxi Li, Justin Boutilier, Yonatan Mintz
pmc-11692326.description: Person-centered care (PCC), or care consistent with preferences, improves long-term care (LTC) resident quality of life, family satisfaction, and staff job satisfaction. Despite benefits, PCC has not been fully adopted across homes. One barrier is a lack of knowledge regarding patterns in resident preferences that can meaningfully inform operational decision-making to improve PCC.

pmc-12653245.title: The Role of High-Sensitivity Cardiac Troponin and Ischemia-Modified Albumin in Patients with Lower Extremity Peripheral Arterial Disease
pmc-12653245.creator: Vinko Boc, Aleš Blinc, Anja Boc, Cristiano Fava, Daniel P Zalewski
pmc-12653245.description: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) is a growing global health concern associated with substantial morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. Prognostic stratification is currently based largely on clinical presentation, but patients with similar symptoms can have heterogeneous outcomes. Reliable biomarkers could improve the risk assessment of PAD patients and enable individualized patient management.

pmc-13082460.title: Human-AI Cooperation in Healthcare and Rehabilitation
pmc-13082460.creator: Austin Brockmeier, Panagiotis Artemiadis, Hacene Boukari, Chris Callison-Burch, Eric Eaton, Joel Harley, Thomas Powers, Jose C. Principe, Darcy Reisman, Cathy Wu
pmc-13082460.description: Rehabilitation after injury or to manage chronic health conditions requires continuous reassessment and intervention across time scales ranging from seconds to months. Advances in sensors and data collection, coupled with new technology to administer interventions, create numerous possibilities—including at-home care. The increased capabilities enable automated analysis and control using artificial intelligence (AI).

pmc-13157810.title: Arterial Stiffness in Pre-COPD/PRISm, and COPD Stages: A Cross-Sectional Assessment of Hemodynamic Determinants
pmc-13157810.creator: Şaban Melih Şimşek, Gökhan Gök, Ruhsel Cörüt, Numan Kılıç
pmc-13157810.description: PurposeArterial stiffness is associated with increased cardiovascular risk in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, whether this increase reflects disease-specific vascular effects or is primarily driven by age and hemodynamic factors remains unclear, particularly in early disease states such as pre-COPD and preserved ratio impaired spirometry (PRISm).

pmc-13390996.title: The effect of Bach flower remedies on hope and quality of life in people with advanced cancer: a triple-blind randomized clinical trial
pmc-13390996.creator: Leonel dos Santos Silva, Amanda Gomes de Miranda, Larissa Marcondes, Ruth Natalia Teresa Turrini, Paulo Ricardo Bittencourt Guimarães, Maria de Fátima Mantovani, Luciana de Alcantara Nogueira, Luciana Puchalski Kalinke, Leonel dos Santos Silva, Amanda Gomes de Miranda, Larissa Marcondes, Ruth Natali
pmc-13390996.description: Objective:To evaluate the effect of Bach Flower Remedies Therapy on the hope and quality of life of people with advanced cancer.Method:Randomized, triple-blind (1:1) clinical trial in a high-complexity public hospital in the Southern region of Brazil. Ninety-nine participants were allocated to either the intervention group (solution with nine flower essences) or the placebo group (Hydro-brandy solution).

pmc-13392604.title: Low dose radiotherapy-induced tumor-preferential antigens enhance antibody-drug conjugate efficacy in solid tumors
pmc-13392604.creator: Yun Xing, Yuxuan Yang, Yimin Liu, Teng Yang, Letao Ma, Jiahui Chen, Yang Yang, Yanzhi Xu, Ye Lu, Peng Guo, Peijing Li
pmc-13392604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) efficacy in solid tumors is often limited by low or heterogeneous antigen expression. Here, we investigated low-dose radiotherapy (LDRT) as a noninvasive sensitization strategy to enhance tumor surface antigen expression and improve ADC activity. Transcriptomic profiling and flow cytometry identified ICAM1 as the most strongly radiation-inducible antigen after 2 Gy irradiation, showing an approximately 4-fold increase and exceeding several established ADC targets.

pmc-13637493.title: Inflammation, Endothelial Dysfunction, and Frailty Over 3 Years in Survivors of COVID-19 ARDS vs Pneumonia
pmc-13637493.creator: Zain Khan, Ansley E Jones, William M Gardner, Claire F McGroder, Scarlett O Murphy, Christopher Depender, Margarita Mira-Sanchez, Charity O Ogunlusi, Christine K Garcia, Ying Wei, Matthew R Baldwin
pmc-13637493.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BACKGROUND:Inflammation and endothelial dysfunction are associated with increased severity and mortality in COVID-19 ARDS.RESEARCH QUESTIONS:Do survivors of COVID-19 ARDS show greater inflammation, endothelial dysfunction, and frailty over 3 years compared with survivors of COVID-19 pneumonia?STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS:We conducted a single-center prospective cohort study of 150 adults hospitalized during the first COVID-19 wave: 101 patients (67%) with ARDS and 49 patients (33%) with pneumonia requiring only nasal cannula oxygen.
